mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over the past 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a policy response from the Fed and increases equity risk appetite due to expectations of rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 650,000 units over the past month signals a contraction in residential investment, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 95.0 over the past 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces inflation expectations and increases the probability of monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in 70% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, which increases the likelihood of Fed intervention and triggers a risk-on shift in equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure, which leads to expectations of delayed rate cuts and higher real rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rising unemployment rate signals a labor market contraction, which increases the probability of Fed rate cuts and triggers a risk-on rally in equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures below 400,000 million dollars, combined with a contraction in GDP growth, signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
